headline: Drury keep a perfect conference record
dek: Drury's win at McKendree on Wednesday kept their conference record spotless and their season one of six wins against a single defeat, with eighteen goals scored and five conceded. The defeat came at home to Oklahoma Christian before conference play opened, and only Lincoln remain unbeaten by anyone.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-seven goals exceed what the five lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the shape is no longer one bar and a slope, since Maryville's afternoon against them pulled the second bar close.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan, and Lincoln's home match with McKendree, the one conference match of 9 September without a result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference yet to lose: three wins and two draws, seven goals scored and three conceded, with Wednesday's win at Upper Iowa their first away from home since conference play opened.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ten different players have scored for Drury this season, and none of them appears among the conference's scoring leaders.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Southwest Baptist have won three, drawn one and lost two, the defeats at Lincoln on Sunday and Maryville on Wednesday; they have scored twenty-seven and conceded fifteen, and at least eight different players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made twenty-eight saves for Maryville and conceded seven, a save percentage of .800.

last_match.line: Southwest Baptist came as the conference's top scorers; Maryville have yet to lose at home.

next_match.line: Drury have yet to drop a point in conference play; Indianapolis have not lost since their opening conference match at Rockhurst.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
